mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 59 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, though please note that the air quality is at a moderate level of 64.

The City Clerk's Office has launched an I Voted sticker design contest for local students to help create our official stickers for the November election. Community voting for the top designs is now open online through August 7.

There is plenty happening in Verona, starting today with the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus Trivia.
In a report regarding noteworthy calls for service, on July 26, officers arrested a driver for an O W I after stopping them for speeding at 97 miles per hour on US Highways 18 and 151.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM today. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Caramel Turtle.
